data.title: Oral Sentence Studio
data.description: Use both new words in one complete sentence of your own.

challenges.situation: Bunny wants to share a fun ball game with Cat.
examples: Bunny: Do you want to roll this ball with me? Cat: Yes, I love to catch it!
Bunny: Let us roll it fast. Cat: Here it comes back to you!
Bunny: That was a super fun game. Cat: Let us play it once more.

challenges.situation: Panda and Turtle are looking at a pretty garden together.
examples: Panda: Look at the yellow petals. Turtle: They smell so sweet today.
Panda: Would you like some yummy honey? Turtle: Thank you, that sounds very nice.
Panda: We can rest here in the sun. Turtle: This is a happy place to sit.

challenges.situation: Fox and Badger are sitting together to read a fun picture book.
examples: Fox: Can we turn the page now? Badger: Yes, I want to see the dog.
Fox: Point to the big red truck. Badger: Here it is on this paper.
Fox: That was a great story. Badger: Let us read it all again.
